blocks.text: Standard Model un nazariyat ka majmooa hai jo maadde ke sab se chhote tajrubati taur par dekhe gaye zarron aur energy aur maadde ke taamul ko bayan karte hain. Standard Model zarron ki teen qismon se banta hai (Fig. 12.8): quarks, leptons aur bosons. Maadda, jo kaainat ka sirf taqreeban 5% hai, quarks aur leptons se bana hai. Bunyadi bosons teen forces dete hain: electromagnetism, strong nuclear force aur weak nuclear force. 2012 mein daryaft hone wala Higgs boson batata hai ke doosre zarre mass kaise pate hain.

blocks.title: Standard Model ki hudood
blocks.text: Yeh model ab bhi na-mukammal mana jata hai. Is waqt yeh maloom kaainat ki bohat si aham khusoosiyat ki wazahat nahi kar sakta, jaise (i) gravity, (ii) dark matter (kaainat ka 27%) aur (iii) dark energy (kaainat ka 68%).

blocks.prompt: Elementary zarron ki taqseem bayan kijiye (comprehensive question 12.8). Electroweak theory kis ne pesh ki (MCQ 12.15)?
blocks.explanation: Standard Model mein elementary zarre fermions hain, jo maadda banate hain, aur bosons, jo forces le jate hain. Fermions chhe quarks (up, down, charm, strange, top, bottom) hain, jo hadrons banate hain (teen quarks ke baryons, quark aur antiquark ke mesons), aur chhe leptons (electron, muon, tau aur un ke neutrinos); har ek ka antiparticle hai. Bosons photon, gluons, W aur Z, aur Higgs boson hain. Electroweak theory, jo electromagnetic aur weak forces ko milati hai, Dr. Abdus Salam ne Glashow aur Weinberg ke saath banai (Nobel Prize 1979): option (d).

items: Standard Model: quarks aur leptons (maadda, kaainat ka taqreeban 5%) aur electromagnetic, strong aur weak forces le jane wale bosons; Higgs boson (2012) mass ki wazahat karta hai. Yeh abhi gravity, dark matter (27%) ya dark energy (68%) ki wazahat nahi karta.
